about_the_game:
Based on music spectrum driven paper dance engine, you can customize your favorite skins, paper figures, background images, dance scripts, choose your favorite music, set parameters to generate unexpected and creative dances, funny and funny dances that make people laugh.

Its principle is to automatically rotate the joints of the paper figure under the influence of the music spectrum, and to achieve the dance of the paper figure by configuring parameters, allowing your paper figure to create various dance movements under the influence of the music spectrum.

Under the software installation directory

The Resource folder contains usage instructions and some dance script templates

They can help you quickly master the editing methods and essentials of paper figure dance

These script templates are suitable for any music, but cannot directly produce beautiful dances

It is necessary to modify and adjust parameters based on this until a beautiful dance is produced

Using catchy and rhythmic music makes it easier to design beautiful dances

For example:

Michael Jackson's Billie Jean and You Rock My World

Dance scripts 2, 3, and 4 are recommended to use You Rock My World

Dance scripts 5, 6, and 7 are recommended to use Billie Jean
